title: Day 21/28 - Azure Policy And Governance Terraform Mini Project
description:
Azure Policy And Governance Terraform Mini Project

Welcome to 21/28 day of Terraform Full Course For Beginners
In this video, we'll dive into implementing Azure policies using Terraform for effective cloud governance. Learn how to create and enforce policies at the subscription level with hands-on examples.

⚡️ What You'll Learn:
- How to create and manage Azure Policies with Terraform
- Implementing location-based restrictions
- Controlling VM costs through size restrictions
- Enforcing mandatory resource tagging
- Working with subscription-level policy assignments
- Testing policy enforcement
